ana (Docs): FYI: APAC2 is live and we need a tiny docs pass: add region row, short SDK init snippets, and a concise data residency note. Who can drop snippets?

matt (Eng): I rolled the infra. Host pattern changed to api-{region}.inference.redwood.com. region id = apac-2. Streaming host = stream-apac-2.inference.redwood.com. No API body changes.

ana (Docs): Can you paste 2-line python & node snippets?

matt (Eng): python:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(region='apac-2')
```
node:
```js
import Redwood from '@redwoodai/sdk';
const client = new Redwood({ region: 'apac-2' });
```

jia (Intl): I'll add JP/KR/FR footnotes about data residency in docs/l10n/geo-footnotes.yaml and link from the table.

rachel (Security): Quick reminder: for Private deployments, call out that residency requests may need contractual review. Keep public phrasing high-level.

ana (Docs): Plan: update geo-availability table (add APAC-2), insert SDK lines into Quickstart, add a short footnote "Data residency options available; contact support to request guarantees" linking to support page. I'll open a PR and tag reviewers.

docs-bot: Docs CI: preview built for PR #4722 (:white_check_mark:) https://ci.redwood.ai/pr/4722/preview

ana (Docs): PR #4722 merged and deployed to staging. Will schedule prod push 07:00 UTC tomorrow. Please flag any localization formatting problems here.
